sources.title: Lastbil
sources.excerpt: Lätt lastbil får köra den hastighet som gäller för vägen.
sources.supports: Light lorry ≤3.5 tonnes total weight; heavy >3.5; heavy 90 on motorway/expressway without trailer, 80 on other roads or towing; light without trailer follows road maximum.
sources.scope_limits: Light-lorry statement explicitly scoped to no trailer. Lower road limit still binds heavy lorry; towing light lorry needs M08-L02 combination check. No inference that light lorry towing may always use road maximum.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

sources.title: Traffic Regulation (1998:1276)
sources.version: Existing current statutory source; safe-speed requirement corroborated by current Transportstyrelsen Hastighet page (8 May 2026)
sources.supports: Safe-speed adaptation depends on road/weather/visibility/load and foreseeable stopping distance.
sources.scope_limits: Existing legal teaching reused; current exact agency safe-speed passage directly inspected, not whole statute re-audited during G8.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

sources.title: Lasta bilen säkert
sources.excerpt: Var noga med släpkärrans kultryck så att inte bilen eller kärran lyfter sig.
sources.supports: Incorrect coupling pressure can lift car/trailer and harm handling.
sources.scope_limits: Agency safety background; does not state exact front-axle unloading/steering-grip mechanism or universal numeric towball limit.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

sources.title: Towing a Trailer in Oregon — Being Equipped for Safety
sources.version: Live agency-hosted 32-page brochure; publication date not printed in inspected text
sources.locator: If You Already Have a Tow Vehicle, printed page 6 / PDF page 8; definitions/ratings pp.4–6
sources.excerpt: the tow vehicle will be less responsive to steering
sources.supports: Downward tongue/hitch load defined; excessive load leaves too little weight on front wheels and reduces steering response. Follow actual vehicle/hitch ratings.
sources.fallback_reason: TS/TRV kultryck searches found lifting/handling cautions and calculator scope limits, not the complete front-wheel mechanism. Exact official ODOT brochure passage selected; manufacturer fallback unnecessary.
sources.scope_limits: Conventional rear towball/coupling load explanation, not fifth-wheel geometry. No US percentage, hitch modification recipe, numeric load limit, registration or towing law imported. Front unloading means reduced axle load, not necessarily wheels leaving the road.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

sources.title: Besiktning av fordon
sources.locator: Opening owner responsibility; Vad händer om jag inte besiktar i tid? — Körförbud
sources.excerpt: Om du inte besiktar fordonet i tid, får du automatiskt körförbud
sources.supports: Automatic overdue-inspection prohibition, owner responsibility even without invitation, restricted trips for on/off-road vehicle; dangerous-condition prohibition distinct.
sources.scope_limits: Inträtt körförbud due missed periodic deadline, not dangerous-condition meddelat körförbud. On-road: shortest suitable route to repair workshop/inspection; off-road and still banned: shortest suitable route to nearest inspection business. Does not grant general errands/commuting or waive other requirements.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

sources.publisher: Swedish Government; published by Sveriges riksdag
sources.title: Vehicle Regulation (2009:211)
sources.version: Consolidated live text; chapter 6 §§15–21 checked 13 October 2026
sources.locator: Chapter 6 §15: first calendar month after missed inspection month; §21: prohibition until inspection performed; §§16–17: defects/result
sources.excerpt: Ett körförbud enligt 15 eller 16 § gäller till dess en kontrollbesiktning har genomförts.
sources.supports: Exact start/end of periodic-deadline ban; completed inspection rather than simply booking; follow new findings and any further prohibition/order.
sources.fallback_reason: TS page establishes ban and travel exceptions but does not state precise legal endpoint. Linked primary regulation supplies that missing detail; not an extra duplicate source for the TS-supported ban.
sources.scope_limits: Periodic inspection example only. Inspection being carried out ends §15 deadline ban; not a guarantee the result permits ordinary driving, since defects may create new ban/order. No implication a pass is always required merely to end the original deadline ban.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected

sources.title: Ställa av ditt fordon
sources.locator: Köra ett avställt fordon; opening: prohibition does not automatically create off-road status
sources.excerpt: Fordonet måste vara trafikförsäkrat och det får inte finnas några obetalda fordonsskatter.
sources.supports: General off-road inspection exception requires traffic insurance and no unpaid vehicle taxes; ban does not automatically deregister car.
sources.scope_limits: General off-road rule allows shortest suitable route to/from nearest inspection; when an overdue ban also applies, the additional ban restriction is to nearest inspection. Return is not automatically allowed while that ban continues. This is an explicit intersection of the agency conditions.
sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page or PDF; exact passage inspected
